templates.description: Dependency-free parser for pipe-delimited text table structures generated outside ai_core.

files.content:
from tool import run

sample = """
| Name | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Alpha | 1 |
| Beta | 2 |
"""
result = run({"text": sample})
assert result["status"] == "completed"
assert result["row_count"] == 2
assert result["rows"][0]["Name"] == "Alpha"
assert result["rows"][1]["Value"] == "2"
print("ok")

# structured_text_table_parser

Runtime-generated capability artifact. It parses pipe-delimited text table structures into JSON-like rows and is registered only after sandbox validation succeeds.
